horizons_note: The modelling frame is one-day-ahead per origin (each row's forecast uses only information available the day before). Per-horizon statistics group the test window's final 14 days by day-offset (h=1..14) — descriptive coverage/width by horizon position, not separately calibrated bands. Origin-stacked multi-horizon bands are delivered by the multi-step track ('multistep' key below, protocol direct_multihorizon_v1).

split_conformal.calibration_verdict_rule: coverage pooled over horizons 1..14 of the test window: |coverage - target| <= 0.05 -> calibrated; above target -> conservative; below -> optimistic

band_types.learner: p50 ± q80 split-conformal width per horizon, calibrated on the selection origins, zero-clipped and sorted
band_types.sparse: P(any sale) + quantile ladder of the training history (no collapsing band)
band_types.candidate: peak-capable candidates (hgb_tweedie / hurdle_hgb): point ± q80 split-conformal width per horizon around the candidate's own point forecast, zero-clipped and sorted; sparse rows keep the P(sale)+ladder band

hgb_tweedie.band_type: point ± q80 split-conformal width per horizon, calibrated on the selection origins, zero-clipped and sorted; sparse rows carry the P(sale)+quantile-ladder history band instead

hurdle_hgb.band_type: point ± q80 split-conformal width per horizon, calibrated on the selection origins, zero-clipped and sorted; sparse rows carry the P(sale)+quantile-ladder history band instead

lgbm_tweedie.band_type: point ± q80 split-conformal width per horizon, calibrated on the selection origins, zero-clipped and sorted; sparse rows carry the P(sale)+quantile-ladder history band instead

lgbm_poisson.band_type: point ± q80 split-conformal width per horizon, calibrated on the selection origins, zero-clipped and sorted; sparse rows carry the P(sale)+quantile-ladder history band instead

hurdle_lgbm.band_type: point ± q80 split-conformal width per horizon, calibrated on the selection origins, zero-clipped and sorted; sparse rows carry the P(sale)+quantile-ladder history band instead

sparse_band.definition: P(any sale) = share of non-zero demand days in the training history up to the origin; quantile ladder over the same history

multistep.verdict_rule: |coverage - target| <= 0.05 -> calibrated; above target -> conservative; below -> optimistic (per horizon and pooled)
